senses.gloss: ch. (neut. v.) to be cut, lessened; to be small; to want.
units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 9a:8">Ab. Zar. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>כמה בצרן</he> (Rashi <he>בצירן</he>) how much is wanting yet? <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 14:28">Targ. Prov. XIV, 28</cite> <he>בציר עמא</he> the population is diminishing.—
<cite ref="Chullin 42b:10">Ḥull. 42ᵇ</cite> <he>בצר להו חדא</he> there is, according to him, one less (than the number stated); a. fr.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 13:1">Targ. Y. Deut. XIII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 4:2">IV, 2</cite> (Var. <he>תבַצְּרוּן</he> Pa.).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 15:4">Targ. Job XV, 4</cite>.—
<cite ref="Niddah 65a:12">Nidd. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>למִבְצַר לה חדא</he> to allow her one night less; a. fr.
<cite ref="Menachot 37b:11">Men. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>האי מאן דבַצְּרֵיה לגלימיה</he> he who cuts one corner of his cloak off.—
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 3:5">Targ. Koh. III, 5</cite>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Deuteronomy 4:2">Targ. Deut. IV, 2</cite>, a. e., v. supra.—
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 9b:1">Ab. Zar. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ונְבַצַּר וכ׳</he> we let him deduct therefrom forty eight.
B. Mets. 103ᵇ בַּצְּרִי לך I let thee have it for less.—Denom. בַּצִּירָא one who uses the vowel letters sparingly.

Ab. Zar. 9ᵃ; 9ᵇ and as a mnemonical sign (for remembering when to add and when to deduct) ספרא ב׳ וכ׳ the writer of Bible copies writes many words without the vowel letters (defective) which the Mishnah teacher writes plene
